==Description==
'''Baseplate-W''' was a baseplate with two portals on it, which were connected to each other by a w-shaped path.

This map had the [[April fools 2025]] modifier, which broke enemy appearance and animations.

==Design & Path==
'''Baseplate-W''' was a fairly small and mostly empty baseplate. It only contained three basic cliffs and a w-shaped path.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Baseplate-W}}

==Strategy==
*The best placement spots on this map are in the two v sections of the path.
**As the path is quite small, high range towers can easily cover most of it from the middle.
